title: Formal toric models give log regular geometric stalks
statement:
Let $W$ be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] with a global fs chart $R\to M_W$, structural map $\alpha$, and let $h:R\to Q$ be a homomorphism of fs monoids inducing an isomorphism $R^{\rm gp}\xrightarrow{\sim}Q^{\rm gp}$. Give
$$Z=W\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[R]}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[Q]$$
the associated $Q$-chart log structure [def-pc-fibre-product]. Fix a geometric point $\bar z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Z$, set $\bar w=\operatorname{pr}_W\bar z$, $A=\mathcal O^{\rm sh}_{W,\bar w}$, and use the closed geometric point over $\bar w$ to lift $\bar z$ to $Z_A=\operatorname{Spec}A\times_W Z$ [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Let $\mathfrak q$ be its prime in $A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q]$ and put $B=(A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q])_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Put $G=\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)$, $F=\{q:[q]\in B^\times\}$, $S=R_G/G^{\rm gp}$ and $T=Q_F/F^{\rm gp}$, where $R_G=\{r-g:r\in R,g\in G\}$ and $Q_F=\{q-f:q\in Q,f\in F\}$. Assume $h^{-1}(F)=G$. Put $J=([q]:q\notin F)B$.
Assume there are a sharp chart $a:S\to A$ inducing the characteristic identification and a character $\epsilon:R^{\rm gp}\to A^\times$ with $\alpha(r)=\epsilon(r)a(\bar r)$ on $R_G$. Assume the completion $\widehat A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], compatibly with these monomials, is (a) $k[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]$ or (b) $V[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]/(\theta)$ for finite $n\ge0$, where $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$, $V$ is a Cohen ring for $k$ with uniformizer $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring], and $\theta-p\in([s]:s\ne0,t_1,\ldots,t_n)$. Formal monoid rings mean completions of $E[S][t]$ at $(\mathfrak m_E,[s]:s\ne0,t)$; monoid rings have basis $[s]$ and multiplication $[s][s']=[s+s']$.
Then there is a nonzero complete regular Noetherian local ring $D$ and, putting $H=D[[T]]$, $L=([v]:v\ne0)H$, a pair isomorphism $(\widehat B,J\widehat B)\cong(H,L)$ in case (a), or $(H/(\eta),L(H/(\eta)))$ in case (b), with $\bar\eta\in\mathfrak m_D\setminus\mathfrak m_D^2$. Set $e=0$ or $1$ respectively. The stratum completion is regular and
$$\dim\widehat B=\dim D+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}-e,\quad \dim(\widehat B/J\widehat B)=\dim D-e.$$
The quotient $B/J$ is regular and $\dim B=\dim(B/J)+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}$. The natural map of strict localizations $Z_{A,(\bar z_A)}\to Z_{(\bar z)}$ is an isomorphism over $Z$, respecting every chart monomial, and identifies $\mathcal O^{\rm sh}_{Z,\bar z}$ with $B^{\rm sh}$. Under this identification, the characteristic monoid is $T$, its nonunit log ideal is $JB^{\rm sh}$, the quotient $B^{\rm sh}/JB^{\rm sh}\cong(B/J)^{\rm sh}$ is regular, and
$$\dim B^{\rm sh}=\dim(B^{\rm sh}/JB^{\rm sh})+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}.$$
Thus the $Q$-chart log scheme $Z$ is log regular at $\bar z$. Regularity and dimension are as in [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

Stacks: algebra.tex Tag 00MA (lemma-completion-tensor), Tag 05WS (lemma-quotient-strict-henselization); more-algebra.tex Tags 07NY (lemma-completion-regular), 07NV (lemma-completion-dimension), 06LN (lemma-henselization-regular), 06LK (lemma-henselization-dimension).

proof.text: Apply formal-chart-local-preparation to obtain Noetherian A and B and the contraction equality. The boundary J is contained in m_B, since each of its spanning generators is a nonunit.

Apply chart-face-residual-unit-decomposition to the given chart character and contraction equality, extracting sharp fs T. Apply formal-monoid-extension-model to the given completion in the selected Boolean case, and then extended-formal-model-dimensions to obtain ModelDimensions.

The private regularity_of_model_dimensions proof makes B/J nonzero local, uses completion-of-quotient to identify its completion with Bhat/JBhat, transfers regularity and applies completion regular-iff. A regular local ring is a regular ring. Rewrite the two completed dimensions by completion-dimension, substitute dim D from the stratum formula, rearrange additions and cancel the common Boolean 0 or 1. This proves regularity of B/J and its dimension-plus-rank formula.
Apply formal-chart-strict-comparison without using the model hypotheses. Its regularity implication applies to B/J, and its dimension equalities transport the formula to Bsh and Bsh/JBsh.

Form the induced quotient ring equivalence from the strict-stalk ring equivalence and its ideal-map equation. Transfer regularity and Krull dimensions through these ring equivalences. The characteristic monoid equivalence induces a group-completion equivalence by monoid localization, hence a Z-linear equivalence and a rational base-change equivalence; rank invariance identifies characteristicRank with rank T. Substitute these equalities to obtain the last two clauses. Retain the pointed, monomial, characteristic and quotient comparison equations for the other clauses.
